title: Project Engineer Roads & Infrastructure
questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a Road Engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Have you worked in NSW Government before?
Do you have experience managing the delivery of road, bridge or traffic infrastructure construction or maintenance projects?
